items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 June 2026 8:25am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 25 June 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East or Southeast today, mainly 3 or 4 but occasionally 5 in a few places, mainly in the southeast of the area and around western coasts of the Isle of Man this morning. Becoming Variable 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then scattered showers later, possibly heavy.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 to 5, settling South or Southwest through tomorrow and increasing mainly 5 occasionally 6, but still 3 or 4 in east of area. Then decreasing 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Scattered showers at first, then sreas of mist and fog developing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog.
